sentence: This project develops an orally efficacious ribonucleoside analog and a non-nucleoside companion as antivirals against seasonal and pandemic influenza viruses.
This project studies how gene networks change ethanol drinking in mice and how alcohol use relates to blood pressure and genetics.
This project tries to find out how drugs called targeted therapies work better when combined with a therapy that activates immune cells to attack cancer.
This project uses genome sequencing to rapidly find genetic mutations in infants with rare genetic conditions and tests an antisense oligonucleotide as a personalized therapy.
This project tries to find out how monocytes are reprogrammed during limb ischemia and whether targeting a cholesterol pathway enzyme can help peripheral artery disease.
This project works on using advanced imaging methods to guide and assess cancer treatment in radiation oncology, surgery, and interventional radiology.
This project studies the role of a key chromatin regulator in neurodevelopmental disorders using single-cell epigenomics.
This project studies the barriers to lung cancer screening among current and former smokers and how ready churches are to promote it.
This project develops a proteomic assay of plasma proteins in blood samples to measure how well transplanted stem cell-derived liver cells work.
This project studies how chronic activity of a cell stress response element in tumor associated macrophages shapes angiogenesis and lipogenesis in melanoma.
This project tries to find out how removing a tuberous sclerosis complex gene from mouse Purkinje neurons reduces action potential firing and impairs cerebellar function.
This project studies how methylation of a fusion gene mRNA controls protein level and tumor formation in alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma.
This project builds a web-based dashboard that forecasts which postpartum women with gestational diabetes will develop type 2 diabetes.
This project uses genetic analyses in millions of individuals to find targets for lipids and cardiovascular disease and builds a polygenic score assay.
This project studies how an RNA binding protein helps pancreatic cancer cells metastasize by modifying mRNAs important for cellular adaptation to stress.
This project studies how epigenetic information is established and partitioned into daughter cells in development and regeneration.
This project studies whether defective proviruses in children and young people with perinatal HIV-1 make viral RNA and proteins and affect the immune system.
This project helps investigators with study design, sample preparation and analysis of omics studies and builds bioinformatics methods and tools.
This project studies how phagocytic activity of mesenchymal stromal cells leads to senescence, dysfunction and bone loss in aging.
This project builds platforms for genome-wide functional genomic screens in five cell lines from four different mosquito species.
